_specs: The design name comes from the Shopify image filename, the only record of what the print is. Nothing about the artwork is invented.
buyBody: Mint, spotted. The lightest color we make and the only one that looks like summer from a distance.
pieceHeadline: The only shirt here that isn't neutral
pieceParas: Fresh mint with a spot pattern over it. Everything else in the range is black, white, gray, tan or gold; this is the one that commits to a color.
On the blade collar, which keeps it from tipping over into novelty — the neckline is the plainest thing we do.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body, hard summer light. Mint goes muddy in shade and gray under cloud; this one needs the sun. There is no on-body apparel photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
